sources.title: Temporal Graph Neural Networks for Money Laundering Detection in Cross ...
sources.snippet: Traditional approaches to temporal modeling in AML systems relied on time-windowed aggregation of transaction features, which failed to capture complex temporal dependencies. Recent advances have integrated recurrent neural networks and temporal graph structures to model sequential patterns in transaction data.
